title: Riverside site hours and visitor desk
compartment: shared
---

Published site hours for the Riverside distribution center (fictional).

The visitor desk is open 05:30–19:00 on weekdays and 06:00–14:00 on Saturday
surge days. All roles may read this notice. After hours, use the posted gate
phone on the binder cover.

Cafeteria service follows the same weekday window. There is no cafeteria
coverage on Sunday.
